court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court at Latur, Hindu Marriage petition No.302/2017
case_name: Harsha Vishal Sutar vs Vishal Ramesh Sutar
facts_of_case: The applicant/wife seeks transfer of Hindu Marriage petition to Pandharpur court due to distance and difficulty in traveling alone from her village to Latur.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that it is not possible for her to travel alone from her village to Latur.
legal_principles.held: He submits that it is not possible for the applicant to travel alone from her village to Latur. He submits that one may it take at least 3-4 hours.
use_in: divorce cases where maintenance is sought

legal_principles.principle: A court may transfer a matter to another court if it is in the interest of justice.
legal_principles.held: He submits that in the interest of justice this Court be pleased to transfer Hindu Marriage Petition No.302/2017 filed by respondent/husband u/s 13(1)(ia)(ib)(iii) of Hindu Marriage Act, to Pandharpur Court.
use_in: cases where a transfer is sought

outcome.final_order: The Court transferred the Hindu Marriage petition to Pandharpur court.
